title: This Giant Catfish Throws Itself Onto Land to Eat Pigeons

scenes.text: A giant catfish throws itself onto land to catch pigeons.
It happens on the Tarn River in France.
The fish can be up to six feet long. It surges onto the gravel, often with more than half its body out of the water.
It grabs a pigeon and wriggles back into the river.
Only 28 percent of attacks worked, because a catfish stuck on land can die.
So yes: a fish that hunts birds on the beach.
